fixed_dimensions: every non-var axis is fixed by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and its sgl-amd-mono K2i launch: index_n_heads 32, index_head_dim 128, MXFP4 queries and keys with E8M0 per 32, SGLang's index plane of 64-row pages, 6 DSpark verify rows a request; the indexer is replicated on every TP rank (TP2 / TP4), so no axis depends on TP
notes: num_requests: the AgentX per-session in-flight distribution (k=1 90.0%, 2 5.4%, 3 2.1%, 4 0.85%, ...) convolved over C = 1, 2, 4, 8 concurrent sessions, each concurrency point weighted equally, keeping the steps that fit the kernel's 8 requests (R = sum of the sessions' in-flight requests). ctx: the decode-step-weighted context share by power-of-two bucket (weight = tokens decoded, context = in + out/2), keyed by the bucket's upper edge; the share above 512K (16.7%) is clipped onto 524288. ctx counts the indexed columns of the ratio-1 index sources (layers 20-36; the ratio-2 sources 2, 8, 14 see half). The perf range is the part where the estimated baseline (bytes moved at 4.5 TB/s plus 5 us for its three launches: 68 bytes a key per request, 4 bytes a row per column for the logits and the -inf tail) is >= 10 us with margin: ctx >= 64K at 8 requests and ctx >= 448K at one request; the >= 10 us shapes span about 17x in requests x ctx (one request needs ~245K columns, 8 requests ~40K), so the 100x rule is not reachable. Estimates only: no timing measurement and no live capture yet.
